Title: 1. Three Men and a Baby
description: Jack Holden and his friends, Peter and Michael, spend most of their time having flings with several women in their apartment. Their life changes when a mysterious baby appears at their doorstep.

Title: 2. Fatal Attraction
description: A married man's one-night stand comes back to haunt him when that lover begins to stalk him and his family.

Title: 3. Beverly Hills Cop II
description: Axel Foley returns to Beverly Hills to help Taggart and Rosewood investigate Chief Bogomil's near-fatal shooting and the series of "alphabet crimes" associated with it.

Title: 4. Good Morning, Vietnam
description: In 1965, an unorthodox and irreverent DJ named Adrian Cronauer begins to shake up things when he is assigned to the U.S. Armed Services radio station in Vietnam.

Title: 5. Moonstruck
description: Loretta Castorini, a bookkeeper from Brooklyn, New York, finds herself in a difficult situation when she falls for the brother of the man she has agreed to marry.

Title: 6. The Untouchables
description: During Prohibition, Treasury agent Eliot Ness sets out to stop ruthless Chicago gangster Al Capone, and assembles a small, incorruptible team to help him.

Title: 7. The Secret of My Success
description: A Kansas farm boy goes to New York City and succeeds in business by impersonating an executive.

Title: 8. Stakeout
description: Two detectives observe an escaped convict's ex-girlfriend, but complications set in when one of them falls for her.

Title: 9. Lethal Weapon
description: Two newly paired cops who are complete opposites must put aside their differences in order to catch a gang of drug smugglers.

Title: 10. Dirty Dancing
description: Spending the summer at a Catskills resort with her family, Frances "Baby" Houseman falls in love with the camp's dance instructor, Johnny Castle.

Title: 11. The Witches of Eastwick
description: Three single women in a picturesque village have their wishes granted, at a cost, when a mysterious and flamboyant man arrives in their lives.

Title: 12. Predator
description: A team of commandos on a mission in a Central American jungle find themselves hunted by an extraterrestrial warrior.

Title: 13. Throw Momma from the Train
description: A creative writing teacher suffers from writer's block after his ex-wife stole his novel and published it as her own. A student wants his domineering mother dead, and misunderstands a writing advice as an invitation for a murder swap.

Title: 14. Dragnet
description: The equally strait-laced and "by-the-book" nephew of Joe Friday must work with his more laid-back partner to solve a mystery.

Title: 15. La Bamba
description: Biographical story of the rise from nowhere of early Native Latino American rock and roll singer Ritchie Valens who died at age 17 in a plane crash with Buddy Holly and The Big Bopper.

Title: 16. RoboCop
description: Corporate interests resurrect a murdered police officer as a cybernetic enforcer to privatize security in a decaying Detroit. He executes lethal justice while flickering memories of his former life trigger a hunt for his killers.

Title: 17. Outrageous Fortune
description: Two women unknowingly share the same man, but when he disappears, both go out looking for him and enter his surprisingly dangerous life.

Title: 18. Broadcast News
description: A high-strung news producer finds herself in a love triangle between a talented but self-doubting reporter and a charming new anchor, who embodies the growing trivialization of news that she is determined to fight against.

Title: 19. The Living Daylights
description: James Bond is sent to investigate a KGB policy to kill all enemy spies, and uncovers an arms deal that potentially has major global ramifications.

Title: 20. Eddie Murphy: Raw
description: Eddie Murphy in a stand-up performance recorded live. For an hour and a half he talks about his favourite subjects: sex and women.

Title: 21. Planes, Trains & Automobiles
description: A Chicago advertising man must struggle to travel home from New York for Thanksgiving, with a lovable oaf of a shower-curtain-ring salesman as his only companion.

Title: 22. Full Metal Jacket
description: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.

Title: 23. A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
description: A psychiatrist, familiar with the knife-wielding dream demon Freddy Krueger, helps teens at a mental hospital battle the killer who is invading their dreams.

Title: 24. The Last Emperor
description: Bernardo Bertolucci's Oscar-winning dramatization of China's eleventh and final monarch of the Qing dynasty: Emperor Puyi.

Title: 25. Wall Street
description: An impatient young stockbroker is willing to do anything to get to the top, including trading on illegal inside information taken through a ruthless, greedy corporate raider who takes the youth under his wing.

Title: 26. Mannequin
description: A young artist, searching for his vocation, makes a mannequin so perfect he falls in love with it. Finding the mannequin in a store window, he gets a job there and his creation comes to life.

Title: 27. Roxanne
description: The large-nosed C.D. Bales is in love with the beautiful Roxanne; she falls for his personality but another man's looks.

Title: 28. Blind Date
description: A workaholic needs a date for a dinner with new important clientele, but who his brother sets him up with could lead to disaster.

Title: 29. The Running Man
description: In a future dystopian America, a wrongfully accused and convicted policeman gets his shot at freedom when he's forced to participate in a TV game show where convicts called Runners must battle killers for their freedom.

Title: 30. Spaceballs
description: A star-pilot for hire and his trusty half-dog sidekick must come to the rescue of a spoiled princess and save Planet Druidia from the clutches of the evil Spaceballs.

Title: 31. Summer School
description: Freddy the gym teacher has to teach remedial English in summer (high) school, if he wants tenure. As he can only teach gym and his students want fun, emphasis is on "field trips" - until he's fired unless all his students pass the test.

Title: 32. No Way Out
description: The Secretary of Defense forces a Pentagon naval aide to lead a spy manhunt.

Title: 33. Like Father Like Son
description: A mysterious potion switches the personalities of a buttoned-up doctor and his laid-back son.

Title: 34. Adventures in Babysitting
description: A babysitter must battle her way through the big city after being stranded there with the kids she's looking after.

Title: 35. *batteries not included
description: Aliens help a feisty old New York couple in their battle against the ruthless land developer who's out to evict them.

Title: 36. The Lost Boys
description: When a recently divorced mother and her two teenage boys move to a coastal town to stay with her father, it doesn't take long for the brothers to realize the area is a haven for something much more sinister than party-going surfers.

Title: 37. Can't Buy Me Love
description: An outcast secretly pays the most popular girl in school one thousand dollars to pretend to be his girlfriend for a month.

Title: 38. Nuts
description: A high-class call girl accused of murder fights for the right to stand trial rather than be declared mentally incompetent.

Title: 39. The Princess Bride
description: A bedridden boy's grandfather reads him the story of a farmboy-turned-pirate who encounters numerous obstacles, enemies and allies in his quest to be reunited with his true love.

Title: 40. Revenge of the Nerds II: Nerds in Paradise
description: The rising college nerds set out to a convention in Florida, but are not welcomed by the Alpha Beta representatives.

Title: 41. Harry and the Hendersons
description: While returning from a hunting trip in the woods, George Henderson and his family run into something with their car that turns out to be a Sasquatch. Thinking he is dead, they take him home, but he soon awakens.

Title: 42. Police Academy 4: Citizens on Patrol
description: The misfit Police Academy graduates are assigned to train a group of civilian volunteers to fight crime once again plaguing the streets.

Title: 43. Overboard
description: A cruel heiress mocks and cheats a hired carpenter, but when she develops amnesia after an accident he decides to introduce her to family life by convincing her that they're husband and wife.

Title: 44. Baby Boom
description: The life of super-yuppie J.C. is thrown into turmoil when she inherits a baby from a distant relative.

Title: 45. Innerspace
description: When a test pilot taking part in a secret miniaturization experiment is accidentally injected into a hapless store clerk, the two must work together in order to prevent the technology from falling into the wrong hands.

Title: 46. Tin Men
description: A minor car accident drives two rival aluminum-siding salesmen to the ridiculous extremes of man versus man in 1963 Baltimore.

Title: 47. Black Widow
description: Federal investigator Alexandra Barnes tracks down gold-digging woman Catherine Peterson, who moves from husband to husband in order to kill them and collect the inheritance.

Title: 48. Ernest Goes to Camp
description: Ernest, a lovable loser who works as a summer camp handyman and dreams of becoming a guidance councilor, must find a way to inspire a group of juvenile delinquents as well as stop a shady strip mining company from closing the camp.

Title: 49. Raising Arizona
description: When a childless couple--an ex-con and an ex-cop--decide to help themselves to one of another family's quintuplets, their lives become more complicated than they anticipated.

Title: 50. Benji the Hunted
description: Benji is left in the wilderness after an accident. Can he survive?

Title: 51. Empire of the Sun
description: A teenage English boy struggles to survive with his fellow captives under Japanese occupation of China during World War II.

Title: 52. Jaws: The Revenge
description: Chief Brody's widow believes that her family is deliberately being targeted by another shark in search of revenge.

Title: 53. Hello Again
description: A suburban housewife chokes to death and is brought back to life by a spell cast by her wacky sister.

Title: 54. Critical Condition
description: Con man Kevin Lennihan, framed in a jewel smuggling, tries for an insanity plea, and is sent to a hospital for review, where he is confused for a doctor and takes over the hospital when a major storm hits.

Title: 55. The Principal
description: A teacher is assigned to be the principal of a violent, crime-ridden high school.

Title: 56. Suspect
description: When a homeless man is accused of murdering a Justice Department file clerk, a public defender is tasked with mounting his legal defense.

Title: 57. The Believers
description: Cal Jamison, a police psychologist, is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic murders and a malevolent cult.

Title: 58. Some Kind of Wonderful
description: When Keith goes out with Amanda, the girl of his dreams, Amanda's ex-boyfriend plans to get back at Keith. Meanwhile, Keith's best friend, tomboy Watts, realizes she has feelings for Keith.

Title: 59. Project X
description: An Air Force pilot joins a top secret military experiment involving chimps, but begins to suspect there might be something more to the mysterious "Project X".

Title: 60. Born in East L.A.
description: When an L.A. born American citizen is mistaken for a Mexican illegal alien and deported to Mexico, he has to do everything he can to get across the border.

Title: 61. Masters of the Universe
description: When He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) is driven from Eternia after Skeletor (Frank Langella) seizes Castle Grayskull, a stolen portal device strands the fight on Earth, where a pair of teenagers become entangled in a war that spans worlds.

Title: 62. Angel Heart
description: In 1955 New Orleans, small-time private investigator Harry Angel is hired by a man who calls himself Louis Cypher to track down a singer named Johnny Favorite, but the investigation takes an unexpected and somber turn.

Title: 63. Burglar
description: A corrupt cop blackmails former burglar Bernice, forcing her into her most ambitious job yet: a dentist hires her to break into her ex-husband's house and steal back her jewelry. But when the ex is murdered, Bernice is the only suspect.

Title: 64. Over the Top
description: Tough trucker Lincoln Hawk is determined to win back his son and triumph at the world arm wrestling championships.

Title: 65. Superman IV: The Quest for Peace
description: With the world on the brink of a nuclear war, Superman takes it upon himself to destroy all nuclear weapons. However, Lex Luthor creates Nuclear Man, a force strong enough to take down Superman.

Title: 66. Flowers in the Attic
description: Children are hidden away up in an attic by their conspiring mother and grandmother.

Title: 67. Radio Days
description: A nostalgic look at radio's golden age focusing on one ordinary family and the various performers in the medium.

Title: 68. Hellraiser
description: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

Title: 69. Ishtar
description: Two terrible lounge singers get booked to play a gig in a Moroccan hotel but somehow become pawns in an international power play between the C.I.A., the Emir of Ishtar, and the rebels trying to overthrow his regime.

Title: 70. Prince of Darkness
description: A group of graduate students and scientists uncover an ancient canister in an abandoned church, but when they open the container, they inadvertently unleash a strange liquid and an evil force on all humanity.

Title: 71. Creepshow 2
description: Three macabre tales from the latest issue of a boy's favorite comic book, dealing with a vengeful wooden Native American, a monstrous blob in a lake, and an undying hitchhiker.

Title: 72. Hamburger Hill
description: The story of the 101st Airborne Division in the Vietnam War and their difficult 10-day struggle to take over a strategic mountainside in South Vietnam.

Title: 73. The Gate
description: Kids left home alone accidentally unleash a horde of malevolent demons from a mysterious hole in their suburban backyard.

Title: 74. The Pick-up Artist
description: A womanizer meets his match when he falls for a woman in debt to the mafia.

Title: 75. Back to the Beach
description: Frankie and Annette, having grown up and put aside their beach-partying lifestyle, visit their daughter in Southern California and discover there's still some wild times left in them.

Title: 76. The Bedroom Window
description: A yuppie is suspected of assaulting a woman.

Title: 77. The Fourth Protocol
description: John Preston is a British Agent with the task of preventing the Russians detonating a nuclear explosion next to an American base in the UK. The Russians are hoping this will shatter the "special relationship" between the two countries.

Title: 78. Less Than Zero
description: A college freshman returns to L.A. for the holidays at his ex-girlfriend's request, but discovers that his former best friend has an out-of-control drug habit.

Title: 79. Fatal Beauty
description: Tough narcotics officer, Rita's on-scene of a fatal drug heist. Their's several bodies and a almost pure bag of Fatal Beauty, a drug with PCP and 50% fentanyl. she finds a Kroll Construction van with a dead Kroll employee in it.

Title: 80. Extreme Prejudice
description: A Texas Ranger and a ruthless narcotics kingpin - they were childhood friends, now they are adversaries.

Title: 81. Light of Day
description: A pair of siblings must choose whether to pursue their dream of touring with their rock band or support their family and stay in Cleveland, Ohio.

Title: 82. Disorderlies
description: Three bumbling orderlies are hired to take care of an old rich man. Humorous mayhem follows.

Title: 83. Someone to Watch Over Me
description: A married New York cop falls for the socialite murder witness he's been assigned to protect.

Title: 84. Hope and Glory
description: A young boy living on the outskirts of London comes of age during the uncertain days of World War II.

Title: 85. Maid to Order
description: A spoiled rich girl is visited by her fairy godmother and turned into a maid.

Title: 86. The Hidden
description: A cop and an FBI agent race for answers after law abiding people suddenly become violent criminals.

Title: 87. From the Hip
description: Robin, one year out of law school with one trial, gets set up with an unwinnable murder case for having forced his law firm to make him partner with unethical behavior, tarnishing the firm.

Title: 88. Teen Wolf Too
description: Todd Howard is a struggling college student. Nothing seems to be going very well for him, until he turns into a wolf.

Title: 89. House II: The Second Story
description: The new owner of a sinister house gets involved with reanimated corpses and demons searching for an ancient Aztec skull with magic powers.

Title: 90. Ironweed
description: An alcoholic drifter spends Halloween in his hometown of Albany, New York after returning there for the first time in decades.

Title: 91. Who's That Girl
description: The life of an uptight tax lawyer turns chaotic when he is asked to escort a young woman newly released from prison, who persuades him to help prove her innocence.

Title: 92. Hiding Out
description: A young Boston stockbroker on the run from the mob decides to hide out in his little cousin's small town, and accidentally enrolls as a high-school student.

Title: 93. Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
description: After the death of his girlfriend's daughter from a drug overdose, architect/vigilante Paul Kersey begins pitting two Los Angeles drug cartels against each other, with help from a rich benefactor.

Title: 94. The Chipmunk Adventure
description: The Chipmunks compete with the Chipettes in a round-the-world race.

Title: 95. Assassination
description: A presidential bodyguard is assigned to protect an objectionable first lady as repeated attempts are made on her life.

Title: 96. Evil Dead II
description: Ash Williams, the lone survivor of an earlier onslaught of flesh-possessing spirits, holes up in a cabin with a group of strangers while the demons continue their attack.

Title: 97. Cry Freedom
description: South African journalist Donald Woods is forced to flee the country after attempting to investigate the death in custody of his friend, the Black anti-Apartheid activist Steve Biko.

Title: 98. Surrender
description: A wealthy writer, who has had terrible experiences with money-hungry girlfriends and ex-wives, pretends to be a broke, washed-up novelist, to see if the woman he loves wants him for himself, or just for his money.

Title: 99. Nadine
description: In 1950s Texas, a woman trying to recover sexy photos of herself and divorce her husband witnesses a murder and uncovers corrupt land dealings.

Title: 100. The Sicilian
description: Egocentric bandit Salvatore Giuliano fights the Church, the Mafia, and the landed gentry while leading a populist movement for Sicilian independence.

Title: 101. Gardens of Stone
description: A Sergeant must deal with his desires to save the lives of young soldiers being sent to Viet Nam. Continuously denied the chance to teach the soldiers about his experiences, he settles for trying to help the son of an old Army buddy.

Title: 102. Hollywood Shuffle
description: An actor imagines, in vignettes, how Hollywood stereotypes his race.

Title: 103. Leonard Part 6
description: Secret Agent Leonard Parker is called out of retirement to save the world from evil genius Medusa Johnson.

Title: 104. Made in Heaven
description: After being dumped by his girlfriend, a boy runs away to California. But he ends up in heaven because he dies after trying to help a family from drowning in a river. In heaven he'll meet a beautiful girl, who has never reincarnated before.

Title: 105. Death Before Dishonor
description: A tough Marine sergeant arrives at a Middle Eastern embassy, facing strict limitations on his duties. When terrorists strike and take hostages, he defies orders and restrictions, launching a solo mission to save the captives.

Title: 106. Au Revoir Les Enfants
description: A French boarding school run by priests seems to be a haven from World War II until a new student arrives. Occupying the next bed in the dormitory to the top student in his class, the two young boys begin to form a bond.

Title: 107. Babette's Feast
description: During the late 19th century, a strict religious community in a Danish village takes in a French refugee from the Franco-Prussian War as a servant to the late pastor's daughters.

Title: 108. The Dead
description: Gabriel Conroy and wife Gretta attend an early January dinner with friends at the home of his spinster aunts, an evening which results in an epiphany for both of them.

Title: 109. Best Seller
description: An ex-hit man wants a police detective/novelist to write his biography.

Title: 110. Hot Pursuit
description: Dan arrives too late for his girlfriend's family's plane to the Caribbean. He gets the next one, and once there his hot pursuit of her includes 3 friendly locals, a dubious yacht skipper, corrupt police, a hijacker, and pirates.

Title: 111. American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
description: On a remote Caribbean island, Army Ranger Joe Armstrong investigates the disappearance of several marines, which leads him to The Lion, a super-criminal who has kidnapped a local scientist and mass-produced an army of mutant Ninja warriors.

Title: 112. My Demon Lover
description: A homeless street musician becomes a demon when sexually aroused.

Title: 113. North Shore
description: After learning how to surf by using the local wave tanks, Arizona resident Rick uses his winnings from a recent contest to fly to Hawaii and try to make a living for himself as a professional wave rider.

Title: 114. The Monster Squad
description: A group of 12-year-olds form a Universal Monsters fan club called Monster Squad and attempt to save their hometown from Count Dracula and his fellow monsters when they show up for real.

Title: 115. Three O'Clock High
description: Mild-mannered Jerry Mitchell gets into hot water with quiet bad boy Buddy Revell, who challenges Jerry to a fight on the grounds of their high school after the school day's end.

Title: 116. Bagdad Cafe
description: A lonely German woman ends up in the most desolate motel on Earth and decides to make it brighter.

Title: 117. Big Shots
description: Ivan Reitman brings you Big Shots, a slam-bang comedy-adventure with a heart as big as Chicago.

Title: 118. Near Dark
description: A small-town farmer's son reluctantly joins a traveling group of vampires after he is bitten by a beautiful drifter.

Title: 119. Wings of Desire
description: An angel meets Peter Falk, and loves a French trapeze artist in Berlin.

Title: 120. Wish You Were Here
description: In a staid English seaside town after the Second World War, young Lynda grows up with her widowed father and younger sister. She eventually becomes pregnant by an acquaintance of her father.

Title: 121. Pinocchio and the Emperor of the Night
description: Pinocchio and his friends, a glow worm and a marionette, search for a magic music box. However, so is the evil Scalawag and the Emperor of the Night.

Title: 122. Barfly
description: Based on the life of successful poet Charles Bukowski and his exploits in Hollywood during the 60s, 70s, and 80s.

Title: 123. White Mischief
description: In 1940s Kenya, a love affair between a British aristocrat and a married woman triggers a scandal that shakes the hedonistic Happy Valley society.

Title: 124. Malone
description: An ex-C.I.A. hit man running from his past finds just how difficult it is to retire when he runs across a small town controlled by mercenaries and a family that's resisting their control.

Title: 125. Sign 'o' the Times
description: Highlights from Prince's 1987 European concert tour, including selections from the rock star's album of the same title.

Title: 126. No Man's Land
description: A rookie cop goes undercover and infiltrates a car thief ring.

Title: 127. The Allnighter
description: A Southern California coed parties with her roommates and flirts with a surfer next door.

Title: 128. Hello Mary Lou: Prom Night II
description: Thirty years after her accidental death at her 1957 senior prom, the tortured spirit of prom queen Mary Lou Maloney returns to seek revenge.

Title: 129. The Care Bears Adventure in Wonderland
description: The Care Bears and Alice set out to stop an evil wizard from taking over Wonderland.

Title: 130. House of Games
description: A psychiatrist comes to the aid of a compulsive gambler and is led by a smooth-talking grifter into the shadowy but compelling world of stings, scams, and con men.

Title: 131. The Stepfather
description: After murdering his entire family, a man marries a widow with a teenage daughter in another town and prepares to do it all over again.

Title: 132. Maurice
description: Two English school chums find themselves falling in love at Cambridge. To regain his place in society, Clive gives up Maurice and marries. While staying with Clive and his wife, Maurice discovers romance in the arms of the gamekeeper Alec.

Title: 133. Dead of Winter
description: A fledgling actress is lured to a remote mansion for a screen-test, soon discovering she is actually a prisoner in the middle of a blackmail plot.

Title: 134. The Kindred
description: A geneticist takes his assistants to his old family home to locate the deadly product of his late mother's revolutionary research into rapid human evolution--his monstrous, tentacled baby brother--before a mad scientist gets to him first.

Title: 135. Weeds
description: A San Quentin inmate, sentenced to life without parole, writes a play that catches the interest of a reporter.

Title: 136. The Squeeze
description: A mysterious black box spells danger to a con man and female detective.

Title: 137. Dark Eyes
description: An Italian tells his story of love to a Russian. In a series of flashbacks, Romano Patroni leaves his wife to visit a spa where he falls in love with a Russian woman. He returns to Italy resolved to leave his wife and marry his love.

Title: 138. Russkies
description: A group of American boys and a shipwrecked Russian sailor become friends during the Cold War.

Title: 139. Morgan Stewart's Coming Home
description: A free-spirited teenager attempts to get back in touch with his overly-conservative parents after returning home from years away at a boarding school.

Title: 140. Pelle the Conqueror
description: When his wife dies, Lasse takes his 12-year-old son, Pelle, from their home in Sweden to Denmark in search of a better life.

Title: 141. Date with an Angel
description: An aspiring composer discovers a broken-winged, beautiful angel in his swimming pool. When everyone finds out, he must deal with his jealous fiancée, his future father-in-law, and his friends who have a business plan.

Title: 142. The Curse
description: When a meteorite lands near his family farm during a storm in Tennessee, the son of a struggling farmer believes it's connected to strange plague-like events afflicting the crops, the farm animals and even the family themselves.

Title: 143. Hunk
description: A computer nerd makes a deal with the Devil and gets a new beefcake body.

Title: 144. Personal Services
description: The story of the rise of a madame of a suburban brothel catering to older men, inspired by the real experiences of Cynthia Payne.

Title: 145. The Big Town
description: A dice roller falls in love with a talented dancer who happens to be the wife to a gangster.

Title: 146. The Rosary Murders
description: A priest is put in a dilemma when the serial killer who has been murdering priests and nuns confesses to him.

Title: 147. Matewan
description: A labor union organizer comes to an embattled mining community in 1920 West Virginia, brutally and violently dominated and harassed by the mining company.

Title: 148. Prick Up Your Ears
description: Biographer John Lahr is writing a book about playwright Joe Orton. Joe and Kenneth meet at drama school and live together for ten years as lovers and collaborators. Both want to be writers, but only one of them is successful.

Title: 149. Making Mr. Right
description: A reclusive scientist builds a robot duplicate of himself for a space mission but struggles to program human emotions. He hires an eccentric woman to teach the android how to act like a real person.

Title: 150. Vincent
description: This documentary, on the life of artist Vincent Van Gogh, is told through his letters to his brother Theo, from 1872 until his tragic death. We gain first hand insight into the man, his motivations, and his humanity.

Title: 151. The Garbage Pail Kids Movie
description: Dodger must confront the struggles of life as he is visited by the Garbage Pail Kids and intimidated by some older bullies.

Title: 152. Withnail and I
description: Two sloppy actors spend a weekend holiday at an uncle's country cottage.

Title: 153. Three for the Road
description: A crafty political aide and his soft-spoken pal are assigned the job of delivering a senator's out-of-control teenage daughter to an institution.

Title: 154. A Prayer for the Dying
description: I.R.A. hitman Martin is seen by a Catholic priest while carrying out a hit. He develops a bond with the priest and his niece, but his past and his former employers put all their lives in danger.

Title: 155. I've Heard the Mermaids Singing
description: Scatterbrained Polly gets a job as a secretary in Gabrielle's art gallery. Polly aspires to be a professional photographer, and idolizes Gabrielle for her artistic ability. When Gabrielle rekindles an old romantic relationship with the younger painter Mary, Polly becomes jealous, and discovers Gabrielle is not who she claims to be.

Title: 156. Penitentiary III
description: A man is framed for murder and sent to prison. He is beaten and tortured, then forced to fight the prison's worst killer, a martial-arts fighting midget called Thud.

Title: 157. From a Whisper to a Scream
description: In a small Tennessee town, a historian relates four horror stories to a reporter.

Title: 158. The Whales of August
description: Two aged sisters reflect on life and the past during a late summer day in Maine.

Title: 159. Steele Justice
description: Steele is ex-cop and Vietnam vet who is determined to bring down Kwan, former South Vietnamese general and now rich and powerful drug lord.

Title: 160. China Girl
description: An Italian boy and Chinese girl fall in love in New York, igniting a conflict between their ethnic gangs.

Title: 161. Anna
description: Anna, an aging Czech movie star, comes to NYC struggling to establish her career. When she meets a beautiful, young peasant girl, she teaches her the ins and outs of acting, only to have the young girl become a screen star instead.

Title: 162. Sammy and Rosie Get Laid
description: Sammy and Rosie are an unconventional couple. They live amid chaos, surround themselves with intellectual street people, and sleep with everybody except each other. Things become interesting when Sammy's father visits.

Title: 163. Dancers
description: A successful aging dancer takes a young female protegee.

Title: 164. Return to Horror High
description: In the early 1980s, a series of gruesome murders occurred at Crippen High School. A few years later, a film crew uses the now-abandoned Crippen High as the set for a film. But an uninvited guest makes an appearance on the set.

Title: 165. The Good Wife
description: In pre-WWII Australia, a love triangle develops between a man, his wife and the man's brother.

Title: 166. Nightflyers
description: Professor hires a spaceship to get to the source of weird signals from deep space. The trip is cut short however when the ship's computer gets jealous because the captain is in love with one of the female passengers and it gets homicidal.

Title: 167. Street Smart
description: A New York journalist lies when his fake story about a pimp describes a real pimp up for murder.

Title: 168. Swimming to Cambodia
description: Spalding Gray discusses his participation in the film The Killing Fields (1984) and the background story about the troubles of Cambodia.

Title: 169. 84 Charing Cross Road
description: Based on the true story of a transatlantic business correspondence about used books, which later developed into a close, long-distance friendship that evolved over the course of two decades.

Title: 170. The Outing
description: A group of high schoolers decides to stay in a natural museum during closing hours, but a newly acquired and mysterious lamp, which hides a deadly force, will turn the fun into horror.

Title: 171. Housekeeping
description: After their mother commits suicide, two sisters end up living with their kind but peculiar aunt in their grandmother's old house in a small 1950s town.

Title: 172. Aria
description: Ten short films by ten different directors, set to arias by different composers.

Title: 173. Cross My Heart
description: A man and a woman go out on a "big" third date. He's ashamed to admit he just lost his job, and she's afraid he'll run away if he finds out that she has a kid. Small lies lead to bigger ones and the night gets crazy very soon.

Title: 174. Little Dorrit
description: Arthur returns to London after working abroad for many years with his now deceased father. Almost at once he becomes involved in the problems of his mother's seamstress Amy and of her father residing in the Marshalsea debtors' prison.

Title: 175. In the Mood
description: A 14-year-old nicknamed the 'Woo Woo Kid', is a teenage casanova who has affairs and runs away to marry two older women, mothers themselves, fascinating the public and the media with his romantic prowess.

Title: 176. Campus Man
description: Todd Barret is an aspiring businessman. He has what it takes to have, but what he doesn't have is enough money to stay in college. So come up with a plan to make the first all-male sports calendar.

Title: 177. Million Dollar Mystery
description: After witnessing an elderly man's dying words, a disparate group of people go on a frenetic treasure hunt for 4 million dollars, with each million hidden in a different place.

Title: 178. Five Corners
description: A psychotic young man returns to his old neighborhood after release from prison. He seeks out the woman he previously tried to rape and the man who protected her, with twisted ideas of love for her and hate for him.

Title: 179. A Man in Love
description: An American film-star and an unknown British actress meet on set in Rome. She is angry when he refuses to speak to her journalist father, but later they have a passionate relationship.

Title: 180. Julia and Julia
description: Julia slides between two realities after her husband Paolo's death: one where she's a widow, another where he's alive with their son and she's having an affair. The supernatural shifts blur her grip on reality.

Title: 181. The Glass Menagerie
description: A son longs to escape from his stifling home, where his genteel mother worries about the future prospects of his lame, shy sister.

Title: 182. Real Men
description: A womanizing CIA agent and an insecure insurance agent are paired together to make sure a deal goes through with aliens for the future of mankind.

Title: 183. Tough Guys Don't Dance
description: Writer, ex-con and 40-something bottle-baby Tim Madden, who is prone to black-outs, awakens from a two-week bender to discover a pool of blood in his car.

Title: 184. Nowhere to Hide
description: Marine Rob Cutter discovers defective helicopter parts. Before exposing this, he's killed by corrupt General Howard. Howard pursues Rob's wife Barbara and son Johnny for evidence, underestimating her determination to protect her child.

Title: 185. Boyfriends and Girlfriends
description: In Paris outskirts Blanche, a young clerk, befriends Lea, a girl livelier than she is. Lea is going steady with Fabien who is a friend to Alexandre who is going steady with Adrienne but is however loved by Blanche. Somehow a way has to be found to get out of this emotional chaos!

Title: 186. Bulletproof
description: Oft-wounded L.A. cop Gary Busey invades Mexico to rescue U.S. Army types from a Soviet Agent. Henry Silva, Darlanne Fluege.

Title: 187. The Barbarians
description: Two twin barbarians seek revenge from the warlord who massacred their tribe and captured them when they were small children.

Title: 188. Rampage
description: Alex is an outwardly normal man who goes on killing and mutilating sprees. When he is finally captured and brought to trial, the district attorney is torn between his own liberal ideals on guilt and the crimes the accused is being tried.

Title: 189. Beyond Therapy
description: A few unusual characters and their unconventional therapists cross paths resulting in hilarious interactions.

Title: 190. The Hanoi Hilton
description: Follows the suffering, torture, and brutal treatment that American prisoners of war had to deal with on a daily basis while in North Vietnam's Hoa Lo prison.

Title: 191. Waiting for the Moon
description: Sundance prizewinner. Fictionalized portrait of one of history's great literary couples: Stein & Toklas. Summer 1930s France, Alice tends to ailing Gertrude; they visit Fernande Olivier, Guillaume Apollinaire, others; and Hemingway pops in.

Title: 192. Sister, Sister
description: Two sisters turn their family mansion in Louisiana into a guest house. One of their guests is an aide to a congressman, and turns their lives inside out.

Title: 193. Chuck Berry: Hail! Hail! Rock 'n' Roll
description: This documentary movie covers two concerts at the Fox Theatre in St. Louis, Missouri, to celebrate Chuck Berry's 60th birthday, and also discusses his life and career.

Title: 194. Siesta
description: An American skydiver wakes up in the middle of nowhere in Spain and must recount the last five agonizing days to figure out how she got there.

Title: 195. Steel Dawn
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a warrior wandering through the desert comes upon a group of settlers who are being menaced by the leader of a murderous gang who's after the water they control.

Title: 196. Amazon Women on the Moon
description: A spoof of low budget 1950s science-fiction movies, interspersed with various comedy sketches and fake commercials making fun of late-night television.

Title: 197. Man on Fire
description: A former CIA agent, Christian Creasy, becomes in Italy the bodyguard of a girl who awakens in him a tenderness he never felt before. When she is abducted, Creasy's fiery rage is unleashed, and he embarks on a bloody revenge spree.

Title: 198. The Killing Time
description: A murderer who assumes the identity of a new deputy is unbeknownst to the sheriff planning to pin a separate murder on him.

Title: 199. September
description: At a summer house in Vermont, neighbor Howard falls in love with Lane, who's in a relationship with Peter, who's falling for Stephanie, who's married with children.

Title: 200. Number One with a Bullet
description: Frustrated from not being able to implicate a drug kingpin after months of steak-outs, a police detective with a troubled marriage, and his womanizing partner, do whatever it takes, legal or otherwise, in order to catch him in the act.

Title: 201. Slam Dance
description: An artist, framed for the murder of a woman, is drawn into a web of corruption, blackmail and deceit.

Title: 202. Gandahar
description: An evil force begins to destroy the idyllic paradise of Gandahar, where the citizens are in perfect harmony with nature.

Title: 203. Summer Heat
description: Roxy, a Depression-era farmer, feels alone and neglected by her husband, who works too much, and is drawn into an ill-advised affair with Jack, her day laborer.

Title: 204. The Family
description: With the background of the XX century Italian history, Carlo, a retired teacher, traces the vicissitudes of his family.

Title: 205. Prison
description: The spirit of a long-dead prisoner returns for revenge, haunting the prison's new governor.

Title: 206. World Gone Wild
description: In the nuclear wasteland of Earth in the year 2087, the outpost of Lost Wells has precious water. When an evil cult threatens to steal it, their only hope lies with a mercenary from a cannibalistic city, but survival is not guaranteed.

Title: 207. Promised Land
description: Gritty drama that follows two high school acquaintances, Hancock, a basketball star, and Danny, a geek turned drifter, after they graduate.

Title: 208. White Water Summer
description: The story of a shy boy who gets convinced by his parents to spend a few summer days in the mountains. So, he joins a group, and the vacation begins. Unfortunately, things turn out to be a little tough for our small friend.

Title: 209. Rent-a-Cop
description: Detective Tony is forced to retire and become a store rent-a-cop when his drug sting operation comes to a tragic end by a masked killer. He joins forces with a prostitute, the only one able to identify the killer, to bring him to justice.

Title: 210. Cold Steel
description: On Christmas Eve Johnny Modine's father is murdered by a psycho cut-throat. The cop swears bloody revenge, though he's taken off the case. He doesn't suspect yet that he's also target in a diabolic plan of revenge.

Title: 211. Orphans
description: Brothers Treat and Philip have lived alone since they were kids. Interdependent, they dwell in a loft house and live on little thefts, until an aging minor criminal moves in with them and takes over the role of a father.

Title: 212. Weapons of the Spirit
description: Pierre Sauvage was born in a small village in France in 1944, among what would become as many as 5000 Jews who were helped by the collective efforts of the town, hidden from occupying Nazis by the kindly residents. This is a documentary by Sauvage that explores the supernatural good will by the people in the village. Archival footage and interviews with surviving villagers illustrate their attitude toward their God, their obedience and the actions that saved the lives of thousands of people.

Title: 213. Bellman and True
description: Hiller, a computer expert, was bribed by a group of bank robbers to obtain details of the security system at a newly-built bank. Having obtained the information, he thought he'd seen the last of the robbers. But now they've traced him and his son to London. They hold the son hostage and force Hiller to decode the information about the alarm and then to take part in the robbery.

Title: 214. Square Dance
description: A 13-year-old girl exchanges a pleasant life in the countryside for a troubled life in the city.

Title: 215. The Year My Voice Broke
description: In rural 1960s Australia, a boy watches helplessly as his best friend falls in love with a small-time criminal, setting off a violent chain of events.

Title: 216. Beatrice
description: In Medieval France, a warrior returns home after four years of war and captivity. It is his delicate daughter who must deal now with his rage and frustration.

Title: 217. Straight to Hell
description: After burying a suitcase full of stolen money in the desert, four bank robbers find themselves in a surreal town full of coffee-addicted cowboys and killers.

Title: 218. The Princess Academy
description: Lowbrow humor is the feature in this 'Porky's for girls'. The students of an elite international private school that teaches rich young women how to behave like proper ladies rebel against their strict, snobbish and brutish head teacher.

Title: 219. Eat the Rich
description: Terrorists and a rude waiter attack a politician and take over an exclusive London club.

Title: 220. Good Morning Babylon
description: After the bankruptcy of their father's stonemasonry firm, Nicola and Andrea emigrate to America to restore their fortunes. After many adventures and near-disasters, they end up in Hollywood designing sets for D.W. Griffith and marry beautiful actresses, but tragedy strikes with the arrival of World War I, which finds the brothers fighting on opposite sides...

Title: 221. My Best Friend Is a Vampire
description: After a weird sexual encounter with a beautiful woman, a teenage delivery boy finds himself turning into a vampire, while being pursued by a couple of clumsy vampire hunters.

Title: 222. Pass the Ammo
description: Televangelist's congregation gets taken hostage by woman seeking revenge for stolen inheritance. Black comedy exposing corrupt preachers.

Title: 223. Lady Beware
description: Cute Katya starts as window dresser at a Pittsburgh department store. She dates a reporter. A fan stalks her and is increasingly nasty.

Title: 224. Gor
description: American professor Tarl Cabot is transported via a magical ring to planet Gor, where he must help an oppressed country overthrow its evil king and his barbarian henchmen.

Title: 225. Witness in the War Zone
description: An American journalist is set up and fed false information after the Lebanon war.

Title: 226. Intervista
description: Federico Fellini accepts the request of a television crew to be interviewed about his career, narrating memories, dreams, realities and fantasies.

Title: 227. Gaby: A True Story
description: The life of Gaby Brimmer, a girl physically handicapped, who finally gets her goals of study and triumph.

Title: 228. Rita, Sue and Bob Too
description: Realistic story of working-class Yorkshire life, alternately serious and light-hearted, as two schoolgirls have a sexual fling with a married man.

Title: 229. The Kitchen Toto
description: The son of a priest slain by the Mau Mau moves in with a police officer and his wife in 1950 Kenya.

Title: 230. No Picnic
description: A black-and-white love letter to pre-gentrification New York City, Phil Hartman's NO PICNIC captures a remote time and place - the East Village circa 1985, a vibrant, seedy neighborhood populated by musicians, pimps and poets. Macabee Cohen (David Brisbin), whose heyday as a rock musician is long gone, travels the city in a beat-up VW bus, supplying records to local juke boxes. His beloved Lower East Side neighborhood is in turmoil: rampant real estate speculation, tenants on rent strike, art invading the bars - "in my own neighborhood, I felt like I was in the middle of a party that I hadn't been invited to," he says. Mac's personal life is in turmoil, too: his girlfriend dumped him for the Air Force, his neighbor is pressuring him into a green card marriage, his father has left his mother for a younger man, and his brother is sending post cards from his sexual sojourn to all fifty states. Then a mysterious girl appears in his life, and Mac's obsession to find her becomes a quest of self-discovery, too - "I was looking for someone to save," he says, "to save myself."

Title: 231. Heaven
description: People discuss their afterlife beliefs in filmed interviews with unusual backgrounds, mixed with classic movie scenes and stock footage.

Title: 232. Captive Hearts
description: December 1944. As their bomber is shot down during a mission over Japan, Sergeant McManus and Robert, a young lieutenant, have no other choice but make a parachute jump. They are captured by local villagers and are saved from execution by Fukushima, the village elder. McManus never accepts his lot unlike Robert, who soon takes an interest in Japanese customs and rites. More, he falls in love with pretty Miyoko, Fukushima's widowed daughter-in-law...

Title: 233. Law of Desire
description: A gay filmmaker becomes involved with an obsessive fan while still pining for his absent true love. Meanwhile, he shares a close but complex relationship with his trans sister, an actress.

Title: 234. Under the Sun of Satan
description: A priest stuck in a rural congregation and burdened with his overwrought spirituality, finds purpose in a troubled woman accused of murder.

Title: 235. Nice Girls Don't Explode
description: A young lady is kept away from boys by her overprotective mother because flames tend to spontaneously erupt whenever her hormones are aroused; for her, "protection" on a dinner date is carrying a fire extinguisher.

Title: 236. King Lear
description: A descendant of Shakespeare tries to restore his plays in a world rebuilding itself after the Chernobyl catastrophe obliterates most of human civilization.

Title: 237. Love at Stake
description: In this spoof inspired by the Salem witch trials the town's mayor and the judge agree to sentence several innocent townspeople to death for witchcraft in order to confiscate their land for themselves. However, sexy real witches show up.

Title: 238. Rachel River
description: Comedy drama about a young journalist (Pamela Reed) who, upon returning to her Minnesota home town, begins to examine her life.

Title: 239. Royal Space Force: The Wings of Honneamise
description: A young astronaut participates in a controversial fledgling space program.

Title: 240. Happy New Year
description: Nick and Charlie (Peter Falk and Charles Durning) are two crooks that rob Harry Winston's jewelry store. Nick portrays a rich elderly brother and sister by using prosthetics and make-up to con the manager.

Title: 241. The Lighthorsemen
description: In 1917 when the British forces are bogged down in front of the Turkish and German lines in Palestine they rely on the Australian light horse regiment to break the deadlock.

Title: 242. End of the Line
description: When the closure of a railway is announced, employees commandeer a locomotive to get to corporate headquarters and confront the president.

Title: 243. Echoes of Paradise
description: The love story between an Australian woman and a Balinese dancer.

Title: 244. One Day in the Life of Andrei Arsenevitch
description: A documentary made prior to the death of filmmaker Andrei Tarkovsky, showing him working on his final film "The Sacrifice". This documentation was made at Tarkovsky's request to stand as a record of his working practices. Interspersed with clips of the director's previous films, this should prove especially interesting for fans of Tarkovsky's work.

Title: 245. Four Adventures of Reinette and Mirabelle
description: Two unlike girls are going to learn each other's world - lovely countryside and bustling Paris.

Title: 246. Zombie High
description: A college freshman begins to notice that students at her new school are losing their individuality. She discovers that the faculty are operating on the students' brains to make them docile and productive, but she's having none of it.

Title: 247. Cobra Verde
description: During the 1800s, paroled Brazilian bandit Cobra Verde is sent to West Africa with a few troops to man an old Portuguese fort and to convince the local African ruler to resume the slave trade with Brazil.

Title: 248. The Time Guardian
description: A time traveling city under attack by cyborg robots in 4039 travels back in time sending two troopers in advance to the Australian desert year 1988 to prepare for its arrival. The enemy tracks them.

Title: 249. Home Is Where the Hart Is
description: Nurse and con artist Belle Haimes (Valri Bromfield) lives with her dull-witted husband Rex Haimes (Stephen E. Miller) in the Hart Mansion in British Columbia. There she cares for the invalid, 103 year-old Slim Hart, aka Pappy, (Joe Austin) and his wife, Minnie (Enid Saunders) who is in a coma. Waking up from a sleep, Belle is not enthusiastic about returning to her job and overhears the night nurse (Leslie Jones) reading a postcard from the Hart's two twin boys, Martin Hart (Eric Christmas) and Art Hart (Ted Stidder) that they will be returning home soon. Belle plots the death of old Mrs. Hart and the kidnapping of Old Pappy but things don't go quite according to plan.

Title: 250. Iron Warrior
description: Ator and his brother are separated as children by the evil witch Phoedra. 18 years later, she takes over the kingdom with the help of a masked warrior. Ator rescues the rightful heir princess Janna, and they struggle to topple the witch.

Title: 251. Pathfinder
description: A young Sámi man witnesses a band of vicious raiders slay his family and flees to a nearby village, where he learns he must become a Pathfinder.

Title: 252. Hotel Colonial
description: Marco Venieri receives word that his brother Luca, an ex-terrorist turned state's evidence, has killed himself in Columbia. Marco takes the journey to Columbia only to find a country permeated with poverty, corruption, racism and crime.

Title: 253. Candy Mountain
description: A struggling musician sets out to find the legendary guitar maker Elmore Silk, with whom he hopes to strike a deal to make himself rich and famous.

Title: 254. Sweet Country
description: A U.S. woman joins the underground in 1973 Chile against the horrors of its military regime.

Title: 255. Daughter of the Nile
description: The eldest daughter of a broken and troubled family works to keep the family together and look after her younger siblings, who are slipping into a life of crime.

Title: 256. Wicked City
description: While protecting a signatory to a peace treaty between their peoples, a male human and a female demon discover that their mutual attraction may be the key to unifying their worlds.

Title: 257. An Autumn's Tale
description: Filmed in New York, story of naive young woman from Hong Kong who goes to New York to study. Street-wise cabbie cousin takes care of her in the big city.

Title: 258. Bad Taste
description: The population of a small town disappears and is replaced by aliens that chase human flesh for their intergalactic fast-food chain.

Title: 259. Terror Squad
description: A squad of Libyan terrorists infiltrate the city of Kokomo, Indiana, and take over a nuclear power plant. A counter-terrorist expert must stop them before they blow it up.

Title: 260. City on Fire
description: An undercover cop infiltrates a gang of thieves who plan to rob a jewelry store.

Title: 261. Where Is the Friend's House?
description: Eight-year-old Ahmed has mistakenly taken his friend Mohammad's notebook. He wants to return it, or else his friend will be expelled from school. The boy determinedly sets out to find Mohammad's home in the neighbouring village.

Title: 262. Nayakan
description: A common man's struggles against a corrupt police force put him on the wrong side of the law. He becomes a don, who is loved and respected by many, but his growing power and influence exact a heavy toll.

Title: 263. Opera
description: A young opera singer on the cusp of stardom is hounded by a psychopath with a connection to her past, who forces her to watch as he brutally murders her friends and colleagues.

Title: 264. Neo Tokyo
description: In the future, a race car driver uses his psychokinetic abilities against his opponents.

Title: 265. A Chinese Ghost Story
description: A debt collector has no other choice than to spend the night in a haunted temple, where he encounters a female ghost, whom he falls in love with. To save her soul he must work with a monk to defeat the tree demon who owns her spirit.

Title: 266. Mio in the Land of Faraway
description: A lonely boy who is transferred from his dull life with his adoptive parents to the land where his real father is the King. In that country, he sets out on a quest, together with his new friend, to destroy the evil Knight Kato.

Title: 267. Talking Walls
description: A sociology student films sexual encounters in a motel for his thesis, and falls in love with a French girl in the process.

Title: 268. A Return to Salem's Lot
description: A man and his son vacation to the quiet vampire populated town of Salem's Lot.

Title: 269. Blood Rage
description: A boy kills a man and accuses his twin brother of the murder, and the innocent brother ends up institutionalized, while his psychotic twin goes free. 10 years later, the innocent twin escapes, which triggers his brother into killing again.

Title: 270. Anguish
description: A controlling mother uses telepathic powers to send her middle-aged son on a killing spree.

Title: 271. Eastern Condors
description: A group of Asian prisoners is recruited, trained, armed and sent to Vietnam to destroy a cache of American weapons left behind after the Vietnam War, before the Vietcong discovers its location.

Title: 272. Born of Fire
description: A musician searches for the Master Flautist, a supernatural creature who is planning to blow up the world.

Title: 273. Backfire
description: Disgruntled wife cheats on her well off husband, who's been suffering from PTSD ever since he came home from the Vietnam War. After an incident he ends up in a catatonic state. Soon, she begins to suspect that someone is after her.

Title: 274. Mr. Muhsin
description: Ingenuous countryman Ali Nazik moves to Istanbul, expecting help to become a famous singer, he finds Muhsin Kanadikirik, a fading music producer.

Title: 275. Delirium
description: Models working for a nude magazine are being killed gruesomely. The murderer stages and photographs the victims' corpses, submitting the images for publication.

Title: 276. Ice Palace
description: A couple of twelve-year-old Norwegian girls struggle with their intense, taboo relationship during the 1950s.

Title: 277. The Story of Hachikō
description: The true story about a dog's loyalty to its master, even after his death.

Title: 278. Blood Harvest
description: Jill, visiting home from college, arrives to find her parents missing, and their home vandalized. Soon, matters take a turn for the worse, when she finds herself stalked, and her friends disappearing one by one.

Title: 279. Rouge
description: A 1930s courtesan and a wealthy heir plan to die together, but he never shows up in the afterlife. Fifty years later, her ghost visits a newspaper office to place an ad searching for him, captivating a modern couple with her tragic tale.

Title: 280. Prison on Fire
description: Inside a Hong Kong prison, two inmates form a friendship and face the difficulty of life on the inside.

Title: 281. Street Trash
description: A liquor store owner sells alcoholic beverages to homeless people, unaware of what the bottles actually contain: toxic brew.

Title: 282. Cherry 2000
description: In 2017, a successful businessman travels to the ends of the earth to find that the perfect woman is always under his nose. He hires a sexy renegade tracker to find an exact duplicate of his android wife.

Title: 283. Shy People
description: New York journalist visits her distant cousin for the first time to write an article about her hard life in the bayous of Louisiana. Journalist's wild drug addicted daughter just adds to tensions between two families' cultures.

Title: 284. It's Alive III: Island of the Alive
description: The monster babies have been placed by court order on a deserted island so that they can live out their lives as far away from normal humans as possible without killing them. Enraged by the cynicism toward, and the exploitation of, the monster babies by both the legal system and the media, the man who is responsible for them leads an expedition to the island in order to free them.

Title: 285. Luminous Woman
description: Love story of a mountain man who comes to Tokyo from Hokkaido and a club singer who can no longer sing, with astonishing visual beauty.

Title: 286. Capriccio
description: After the renewed flings with their former lovers prove to be disastrously unlike the romantic memories, an unfaithful couple returns to each other.

Title: 287. The Nest
description: Horrifying shocker as a biological experiment goes haywire when meat-eating mutant roaches invade an island community, terrorizing a peaceful New England fishing village and hideously butchering its citizens.

Title: 288. A Better Tomorrow II
description: A restauranteur teams up with a police officer and his ex-con brother to avenge the death of a friend's daughter.

Title: 289. The Sweet Charm of Sin
description: Arianna recently married a businessman Aurelio and she brings her children, Carlotta and Gustavo to the new family. But Carlotta is attracted by the new stepfather and seduces him. Gustavo, however, prefer a gay relationship with Mario.

Title: 290. Walker
description: An unconventional retelling of the life of William Walker, a 19th century American mercenary leader who became the president of Nicaragua.

Title: 291. Pretty Smart
description: Two private girls' school cliques, one rebellious, the other pristine-join forces to expose their corrupt headmaster who videotapes the girls in their rooms with a hidden surveillance camera and sells drugs on the side.

Title: 292. Blue Monkey
description: Detective Jim Bishop and Dr. Rachel Carson must find a way to stop a giant monstrous insect that's eating people in her quarantined hospital before it procreates and spreads a deadly infection it's carrying.

Title: 293. Blind Chance
description: Witek runs after a train. Three variations follow on how such a seemingly banal incident could influence the rest of Witek's life.

Title: 294. American Gothic
description: After their seaplane malfunctions, a group of travelers make an emergency landing on an island in the Pacific Northwest and stumble across an isolated and psychopathic family.

Title: 295. Mr. India
description: A poor but big-hearted man takes orphans into his home. After discovering his scientist father's invisibility device, he rises to the occasion and fights to save his children and all of India from the clutches of a megalomaniac.

Title: 296. The Caller
description: A widow living in an isolated cabin lets a mysterious stranger use her phone.

Title: 297. Walk Like a Man
description: A boy raised by wolves is reunited as an adult with his real family.

Title: 298. White of the Eye
description: Somebody's killing rich married women in their homes - latest in a rich desert community outside Tucson. A married sound expert is prime suspect.

Title: 299. The Belly of an Architect
description: An architect supervising an exhibition starts to have mysterious stomach pains while his life slowly falls apart.

Title: 300. City of Blood
description: A medical examiner investigating a series of prostitute murders discovers that the culprit is an ancient tribal witch doctor come back to life.

Title: 301. Lust for Freedom
description: A former female cop is framed by corrupt police, acting in collusion with the local judge, and has to fight her way out of the pen, alone, against tough inmates, and the people in charge.

Title: 302. The Emperor's Naked Army Marches On
description: A documentary following Kenzo Okuzaki, a 62-year-old WW2 veteran notorious for his protests against Emperor Hirohito, as he tries to expose the needless executions of two Japanese soldiers during the war.

Title: 303. Evil Cat
description: Master Cheung is the last of a large family whose members for centuries have protected the Earth from a demonic cat with nine lives.

Title: 304. Yeelen
description: A young man with magical powers journeys to his uncle to request help in fighting his sorcerer father.

Title: 305. Hollywood Uncensored
description: Douglas Fairbanks Jr. and later in the movie Peter Fonda narrate the story about the censorship, exploitation and sex in Hollywood movies from the 1930s and the Hays' Motion Picture Production Code to the present day era.

Title: 306. Reflections
description: Piano teacher is deeply traumatised by the events of his childhood, as well as by political oppression in his youth. Decades later, all those traumas lead to carnage.

Title: 307. The Moromete Family
description: The story of a family: Problems, marriage, taxes, revenge, friendship, army and much more.

Title: 308. El día de los albañiles III
description: The masons in the reconstruction of Mexico after the earthquake. Alfonso Zayas works as a bricklayer in a building and his wife has a food stand in the same place. The foreman tries to rape Angelica Chaín (Beatriz), but when he does not succeed, he kills her and chases Pepito, her son, who was an eyewitness to the crime.

Title: 309. Hibiscus Town
description: Love, humiliation, and politics play out in a distant village of China during the Cultural Revolution.

Title: 310. Bizarre
description: A wife escapes her pressure-filled marriage only to have her husband haunt her literally and figuratively.

Title: 311. Eleven Days, Eleven Nights
description: Sarah Asproon (Luciana Ottaviani), a journalist chasing unusual human stories, pulls Michael Terenzi into an eleven day arrangement that challenges his planned marriage and forces him to confront temptation, control, and identity.

Title: 312. The Worst of Faces of Death
description: Includes many disturbing highlights from the first three Faces of Death films, such as animal slaughtering, executions, and more.

Title: 313. Freckled Max and the Spooks
description: Young orphan Max leaves the circus to escape his abusive fosters. Taking a refuge in a desolate castle, he gets acquainted with the most unlikely company: a vampire, a werewolf, the Frankenstein monster - and an extraordinary old lady.

Title: 314. The Puppetoon Movie
description: Salute to the revolutionary Oscar winning stop motion animated Puppetoons created by sci-fi fantasy film legend George Pal. Gumby, Pokey and Arnie the Dinosaur host 12 of Pal's milestone shorts from 1934-1947 that have inspired animation and special effects filmmakers ever since.

Title: 315. Four White Shirts
description: Phone technician Cezars Kalnins in his free time composes songs and performs in a band created with his friends. However getting the band to perform in public has to go a long way in getting permissions.

Title: 316. Plaintiff
description: It is a comedy of stubborn people who initiate a judicial process which would last 7 years because some sheep ate a few cabbages.

Title: 317. Hard Ticket to Hawaii
description: When undercover operatives in Hawaii intercept a cartel's diamond shipment, they must team up with an elite agent to battle ruthless mercenaries—and a giant, toxic mutated python—to survive paradise.

Title: 318. Takin' It All Off
description: A school for strippers is having financial problems and they audition for the Big Owner of the Strip Joint, and he is delighted, except that the new girl can't bring herself to take her clothes off.

Title: 319. Nadodikkattu
description: After losing their jobs in Kerala, Dasan and Vijayan decide to migrate to the Middle East. But they end up in Tamil Nadu where they are mistaken as two CID officers by a group of smugglers.

Title: 320. Slumber Party Massacre II
description: Courtney Bates, the younger sister of Valerie, and her friends go to a condo for a weekend getaway, but Courtney can't get rid of the haunting feeling that a supernatural rockabilly driller killer is coming to murder them all.

Title: 321. My Best Friend's Birthday
description: It's Mickey's Birthday and his girlfriend just left him, so that's when his friend Clarence shows him a birthday he'll never forget.

Title: 322. StageFright
description: The cast and crew of an upcoming show find themselves trapped in a theater with a murderous escaped psychopath.

Title: 323. Cellar Dweller
description: 30 years ago, a comic book artist brings a demonic creature to life through his art. Now, a female comic book artist following in his footsteps is doomed to repeat history when she unleashes the demon again.

Title: 324. Iron Angels
description: A private crimefighting organization is hired by the police commissioner to topple a dangerous drug-smuggling ring headed by a ruthless female martial artist.

Title: 325. Blood Diner
description: Two brothers are entrusted by their uncle to uphold the ritualistic cannibalism of the ancient cult of Sheetar. In order to do so, they have to prepare a feast of sacrifice for the resurrection of their goddess.

Title: 326. A Month in the Country
description: Two soldiers (Colin Firth, Kenneth Branagh) recover from World War I while spending a summer in a Yorkshire village.

Title: 327. Picture of a Nymph
description: Shih Erh (Biao Yuen), a Taoist monk disciple, takes in a scholar named Tsui Hung-Chuen (Lawrence Ng) after he inadvertently burned down his house after battling a demon. Shih Erh and his master Wu Men-Chu (Ma Wu) house and attempt to protect Tsui from the demons and spirits that lurk nearby; however, Tsui encounters a benevolent female ghost named Mo Chiu (Joey Wang), who is confined to the hands of the wicked King Ghost (Elizabeth Lee). As Tsui falls in love with Mo Chiu, he paints a portrait of her, which the spirit uses to conceal herself from the King Ghost's clutches.

Title: 328. Terminus
description: A lone driver navigates a high-tech truck through dangerous territory in a deadly cross-country racing sport. After the guidance system fails, a new driver must bond with the truck's AI while dodging attacks and uncovering sinister plots.

Title: 329. Ghoulies II
description: The Ghoulies wreak havoc at an amusement park's haunted house, disposing of those who mistake them for mere fairground attractions.

Title: 330. Warrior Queen
description: In ancient Pompeii, slaves are bought and sold for household chores and sex. A mysterious queen moves among the elite, while secretly helping the slaves to escape.

Title: 331. Howling III
description: A female werewolf runs away from her family, and falls in love with a man who works in the movie business, while a sociologist who studies these creatures is looking for proof of their existence.

Title: 332. Der Stein des Todes
description: Kuma Cunningham and Jane Lindström are a couple in love. By chance they find a strange stone. Kuma asks Jane to throw away this stone, the stone would be bad luck.

Title: 333. Stripped to Kill
description: When Detective Cody Sheehan discovers the body of a stripper from the Rock Bottom dance club, she wants the case. But the only way Cody can get the assignment is to go undercover - uncovered - at the club.

Title: 334. Thong Girls
description: Three crazy couples in Benidorm, Spain making mischief.

Title: 335. R.O.T.O.R.
description: A prototype crime-fighting robot breaks free from its lab, initiating a relentless rampage as it malfunctions and targets innocents for destruction.

Title: 336. Emmanuelle 5
description: After fans strip her at Cannes, Emmanuelle's luck worsens when a dictator tricks her into his country using her film screening as bait, forcing her into his harem.

Title: 337. Killer Workout
description: Two years ago, a young woman named Valerie was burned after entering a tanning salon. Now, her twin sister, Rhonda, runs a local gym where, all of a sudden, people are being murdered.

Title: 338. Doraemon: Nobita and the Knights on Dinosaurs
description: Origin of species that have evolved differently from human beings.

Title: 339. Homoti
description: Unofficial Turkish remake of E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982)

Title: 340. Munchies
description: A scientist discovers a strange little creature in a cave. The "munchie" is obviously of extraterrestrial origin, but what he doesn't know is the danger it represents.

Title: 341. Rumpelstiltskin
description: A musical version of the classic story about a miller's daughter who receives help from a mischievous dwarf, then ends up over her head. Now, she and a mute servant girl may be the only hope for her baby son, John.

Title: 342. Kachchi Kali
description: A young innocent woman falls for a man who secretly produces adult films. After he betrays and forces her into prostitution, her devoted brother embarks on a desperate search through brothels to find and rescue his sister.

Title: 343. Cyclone
description: A young woman must deliver a top-secret motorcycle to the US military after the man assigned to deliver it, her lover, is murdered by enemy agents.

Title: 344. Hangmen
description: Rob Greene has information about an undercover terror team inside the CIA led by Joe Connelly. To stay alive with the knowledge, he is advised to stay undercover by his supervisor Andrews. Connelly's men try to kill Greene, but he can escape and warns his son Danny that he also may be in danger and that he should look for Dog Thompson, an old military friend of Greene's. Together with Thompson and Bone Conn, another ex-soldier, Danny tries to escape Connelly's henchmen. Meanwhile, Connelly figures that Danny's friend Lisa would make a good target in order to get Danny and also his father.

Title: 345. Silent Night, Deadly Night Part 2
description: The now-adult Ricky talks to a psychiatrist about how he became a murderer after his brother, Billy, died, which leads back to Mother Superior.

Title: 346. Hansel and Gretel
description: After being told to leave their home by their mother, Hansel and Gretel wrongly walk into the 'North woods' where they discover a delicious gingerbread house. Unbeknown to them it's a witch that lives there.

Title: 347. Zombie Nightmare
description: A mother resorts to voodoo to get back at those who killed her son.

Title: 348. Aenigma
description: The spirit of a comatose teenage girl possesses the body of a newcomer to her girls boarding school to enact bloody revenge against the elitist, lingerie-clad coeds responsible for her condition.

Title: 349. Love Rites
description: Hugo, a vain clothing buyer, meets Myriam on a train and pursues a relationship with her. He is delighted to learn she is a prostitute and has no idea she has more in mind than Hugo bargained for.

Title: 350. No Retreat, No Surrender 2
description: American kickboxer Scott Wylde travels to Cambodia to rescue his Vietnamese girlfriend from Russian and Vietnamese forces.

Title: 352. Thoovanathumbikal
description: Jayakrishnan falls in love with two girls, Radha and Clara, and fights his confusion about whom he should marry and spend his life with.

Title: 353. Snow White
description: The ageless tale of a beautiful young princess whose jealous stepmother orders her killed so that she will be 'the fairest in the land.' When the huntsman takes pity on her, he takes her to the house of the seven dwarfs.

Title: 354. Hell High
description: Still haunted by the death of two teens that she accidentally caused as a young girl, a teacher goes berserk when four teens start harassing her, then attack her in her home.

Title: 355. Crazy Love
description: Harry Voss' life spans three pivotal days: his carefree youth, high school graduation, and lonely middle age, exploring life's fleeting moments and unfulfilled dreams.

Title: 356. Obsession: A Taste for Fear
description: Diane, an erotic photographer, must help a rough cop track a killer targeting her models when her ex-husband's bondage films make him the prime suspect, but a red-haired figure on the murder videos threatens her studio and her circle.

Title: 357. Surf Nazis Must Die
description: When the son of a gun-wielding woman is murdered by neo-Nazi surf punks in the post-apocalyptic future, his Mama hunts them down for some bloodthirsty revenge.

Title: 358. Project A 2
description: Dragon is now transferred to be the police head of Sai Wan district, and has to contend with a gangster kingpin, anti-Manchu revolutionaries, some runaway pirates, Manchu Loyalists and a corrupt Police Superintendent.

Title: 359. Lionheart
description: A young knight intent on joining King Richard's crusaders pledges to lead a group of orphans to safety and to protect them from a notorious slaver.

Title: 360. Grotesque
description: A gang of crazed punks breaks into a family's vacation home in the mountains and slaughters the entire family, except for one daughter who gets away.

Title: 361. The House of Bernarda Alba
description: After the death of her husband Bernada Alba puts her daughters under a rigurous mourning which does not even allow them to leave the house for seven years. Adela, the youngest daughter, suffers the most. Pepe el Romano key to all women's despair.

Title: 362. Whoops Apocalypse
description: A British satire on the beginning of WWIII.

Title: 363. The Big Bet
description: A 17-year-old high school student who's obsessed with sex tries to seduce both his beautiful older neighbor and the shy new girl in school over a bet, only to end up falling in love.

Title: 364. Ghost Chase
description: In an old Hollywood mansion, the spirit of an old family retainer inhabits an old grandfather clock. When a movie company uses the mansion for a film, the spirit inhabits the body of a prosthetic robot based on the photo of the butler who then persuades the two filmmakers to track down the Great Grandfather's fortune before the old house is destroyed, revealing a family scandal.

Title: 365. Thaniyavartanam
description: A school teacher living in a village belongs to a family with a history of lunatic males, and soon he falls prey despite being normal due to society misinterpreting his actions.

Title: 366. Pushpaka Vimana
description: An unemployed graduate who coincidentally encounters a rich unconscious man, and takes over his lifestyle by keeping him a prisoner. However, he is in for a twist as a contract killer is after him, assuming him to be the affluent man.

Title: 367. Enemy Territory
description: A desperate insurance salesman has to visit a client who lives in a housing project in a rough neighborhood. Unbeknownst to him, the apartment building is the stomping grounds for a vicious gang, and he inadvertently ignites their ire.

Title: 368. Flower and Snake: Ultimate Rope Discipline
description: A man's gambling debts pile higher and higher and he is desperate enough to have to do something. Well, he can sell off the two women closest to himself of course. The yakuza are buyers of course. The sold mother and daughter are now sexual slaves and while the mother attempts to bargain for her daughter's freedom nothing gives. Escape is also futile.. or rather worse than remaining put.

Title: 369. Olor a muerte
description: The Chemos and the Pachecos are two gangs whose adventures are witnessed by the doctor, the assistant and the social worker of a clinic where they know of the young men's problems.

Title: 370. The Girl
description: A chance encounter on the street brings a young schoolgirl and a wealthy middle-aged attorney together. Thus begins an affair that will lift him into the heights of a passionate love and plunge him into the depths of deception and murder.

Title: 371. Tokyo Bordello
description: A young woman is sold into the famous red light district brothel in Yoshiwara by her bankrupt father.

Title: 372. The Grand Highway
description: 9 year old Louis spends his summer in Brittany. He stays with Marcelle and her husband Pelo while his mother gives birth to her second baby. Louis becomes friends with Martine, 10 year old girl next door, and learns about life from her.

Title: 373. Berserker
description: Six people renting a cabin in the woods of Utah run afoul of a legendary viking warrior who dons the claws and mouth of a bear, with no help in sight.

Title: 374. Programmed to Kill
description: A Lebanese female terrorist is badly injured during an American mercenary operation in Beirut. She's transported back to the US, experimentally operated on, and turned into a cyborg killing machine.

Title: 375. Epidemic
description: A director and screenwriter pen a script and, in the process, blur the line between fiction and reality.
